boards-long-room.line: The long room where House Baroque's board meets.
boards-long-room.short: The room where House Baroque's board meets. Guinevere's father sits at the head of its long table.
boards-long-room.summary: The long room where the board of House Baroque meets. When Guinevere was older, a chair was set for her at its back. From there she saw only the top of her father's chair at the head of the table, a fur collar over it, and one hand on the papers. The board talked in numbers, loans for the dome and for wards rebuilt after raids, and Guinevere counted the people inside them.

broken-bridge.line: A broken bridge high above the burning avenue.
broken-bridge.short: A broken bridge above the avenue. Ruby lands on it when Angela's pink light chases her up a tower.
broken-bridge.summary: A broken bridge spans the avenue in Terrinia. On the evening Oro's ships landed, Angela turned on Ruby, cold and blank. Her pink light chased Ruby up the side of a tower, and Ruby came down on the broken bridge. Angela waited below in the dust.

bunker.line: The raid shelter of the Shield station on the gray plain.
bunker.short: The station's raid shelter. Lesley, the only child there, is meant to go to it in a raid. She goes up the wall instead.
bunker.summary: The bunker is the raid shelter of the Shield station where Lesley lived as a child. She was the only child at the station, and in a raid she was meant to go there. She went up the wall instead. The first time, the sergeant carried her down; after that he only looked. When an Ender crossed the wall, the soldiers fell back to the bunker line, firing, while Lesley lay flat on the wall walk and loaded.

bus-stop.line: The stop on Selena's road to school where her first red alert came.
bus-stop.short: A stop on Selena's road to school, by a fence with a NEXT STOP sign. Her first red alert buzzed there.
bus-stop.summary: A bus stop on Selena's road to school. The road runs between fences hung with signs: NO CROSSING, CAUTION. At the metal fence with the NEXT STOP sign her phone buzzed with her first red alert, and something tugged at every cell in her. That same day, when Chang'e said nobody can get near the void, Selena thought it had got near her fine, at a bus stop.

canal.line: A canal through Terrinia, with a bridge over it.
canal.short: A canal in Terrinia. On the night the base fell, Enders came over it, and Lesley shot one off its bridge.
canal.summary: A canal runs through Terrinia, with a bridge across it. On the night the research base fell, voices on the radio shouted that the Enders were over the canal. One stood on the canal bridge until Lesley, firing from a parapet, put it down.

childrens-homes.line: Homes in Terrinia for children with nobody left.
childrens-homes.short: A home in the city for children. A researcher tells Chang'e it has beds and someone who cooks.
childrens-homes.summary: Terrinia has homes for children who have lost their families. After the base fell, a researcher told Chang'e there was one in the city, with beds and someone who cooks. Chang'e only asked, "Who would finish it?" Later Lesley walked the city's children's homes for weeks with stamped sheets, choosing the children for the Academy's first intake.

cistern.line: A water cistern among the ruins outside the dome.
cistern.short: A cistern in the ruins outside the dome. Vexana drinks from it while the feeders strip the dead houses.
cistern.summary: A water cistern out in the dead ground. In her first weeks away, Vexana went out with the feeders wherever the Will sent her. While they worked, she ate from cans in dead kitchens and drank from the cistern.

citadels-highest-deck.line: The top deck of the Storm Citadel, where Obsidia stands alone.
citadels-highest-deck.short: The highest deck of Obsidia's ship. She stands at its edge alone and tells the empty deck that it is quiet.
citadels-highest-deck.summary: The highest deck of the Storm Citadel. Obsidia stood at its edge as the door closed behind her ship and the Citadel hung in the void. Nothing aboard made a sound. "It's... quiet..." she said to the empty deck. She had absolute control of everything aboard, and it brought her no satisfaction.

citadels-holds.line: The holds of the Storm Citadel, full of silent Enders.
citadels-holds.short: The holds of Obsidia's ship, where thousands of gray Enders stand still and make no sound.
citadels-holds.summary: The holds of the Storm Citadel. Thousands of gray Enders stood still in them, and nothing made a sound. When the pulse changed, Obsidia told the holds, "The Matrix is transmitting," and the crossing began. On the day before the attack the Ultimate Enders stood there with their chests packed with lesser Enders.

city-library.line: Terrinia's library, with long tables for reading.
city-library.short: Terrinia's city library. Selena goes there after a raid to learn why an Ender passed her by.
city-library.summary: The city library of Terrinia. A notice from the Shield of Dawnbreak hangs inside its door, telling people what to do in a raid. After an Ender looked right at Selena and walked on, she went there to learn why. The notice said Enders do not attack each other. Around her, people turned pages at the long tables, and a girl read aloud to her mother.

city-where-six-stars-opened.line: A city on another world, as Obsidia remembers it.
city-where-six-stars-opened.short: A city Obsidia says she watched. Six stars opened over it, and nothing was left standing.
city-where-six-stars-opened.summary: One of the many worlds Obsidia says she has watched. Speaking to Vexana at the end of the rows, she said that over another city six stars opened, and nothing was left standing. She says nothing more of it.

cliff-above-the-water.line: A watch post on the cliff over the bay.
cliff-above-the-water.short: A cliff above the bay. Its watch lamps have doubled since the point of light came out over the water.
cliff-above-the-water.summary: A cliff above the bay, with a watch post and lamps. When a faint point of light came out over the bay, too faint and too far out to fight, the Academy only watched it, and the watch lamps on the cliff doubled. The team radio said the cliff watch was doubled through tonight, with all teams on standby.

climbing-wall.line: A training wall at Selrick Academy.
climbing-wall.short: A climbing wall used in training. Layla makes the climb a race, and Fanny wins without knowing it was one.
climbing-wall.summary: A climbing wall at Selrick Academy, used in training. In her first weeks with Fanny, Layla needled her on it: "Someone up there might need carrying." Fanny said she would look. She reached the top first, found nobody and reported it. She did not seem to know it had been a race.

command-room.line: A room high in the Academy's tower, under the command deck.
command-room.short: A room at the Academy. Chang'e, the director of the Science Division, comes from it after the battle.
command-room.summary: The command room lies high in the Academy's tower, under the command deck, which sits under the glass lab. After the battle with Oro's androids, Chang'e came from it to the monitor room. On the morning the sky opened, Lesley stood at the long window of the deck above it, watching the bay.

concrete-shelter.line: The Academy's concrete siren shelter, with slits for windows.
concrete-shelter.short: A concrete shelter with slits for windows. In a real siren the instructors herd the cadets inside it.
concrete-shelter.summary: A concrete shelter at the Academy, with slits for windows. In the cadets' third week the sirens went for real, and the instructors herded them in: nobody was to leave. Everyone crowded to the slits, Guinevere too. Vexana sat alone on the bench by the door, her hands flat on her knees, and she was the last one out at the all-clear.

corner-building.line: A building on the avenue near the breach.
corner-building.short: A building on the avenue. When the Ender heaves, its front comes down in a slab and strikes Joe.
corner-building.summary: A building on the corner of the avenue, near the breach in the dome. When the Ender heaved, its front came down in a slab. Joe turned his back to cover a girl and her rabbit, and the slab struck him across the shoulders. After the battle it burned floor by floor while Layla stood in front of it, and somewhere in the smoke a man called a name.

counseling-room.line: The counseling room at Selrick Academy.
counseling-room.short: The Academy's counseling room. In the weeks of the search, Guinevere said there that Vexana was alive.
counseling-room.summary: A counseling room at Selrick Academy. In the weeks of the search for Vexana, Guinevere said the same thing there as at the long table: she's alive. When at last she found Vexana on the city platforms, it was nothing like she had pictured.

dark-street.line: A dark street in Selena's earliest memory.
dark-street.short: The dark street where Selena stood barefoot in the mud on her first night, while a hum came down from a black cloud.
dark-street.summary: The dark street of Selena's earliest memory. On the night of the mud she stood in it barefoot in the rain. A hum came down from a black cloud over the bay, with violet light moving in its belly. Then a lamp swung down the street toward her, its flame leaning in the glass, and someone knelt in the mud and gathered her up.

dead-workshop.line: A ruined workshop out in the dead ground.
dead-workshop.short: A dead workshop out on a feeder run. Vexana takes a hammer and an iron bar from it.
dead-workshop.summary: A ruined workshop in the dead ground outside the dome. On a feeder run Vexana took a hammer and an iron bar from it. Her father's screwdriver lay in a toolbox in her room across the city, so the hammer and the bar would have to do. At each dawn after that she scratched a line on the bar.

dead-world-under-a-gray-sky.line: A dead world Obsidia says she watched.
dead-world-under-a-gray-sky.short: A dead world under a gray sky. Obsidia says she saw the body come through a door there.
dead-world-under-a-gray-sky.summary: One of the many worlds Obsidia says she has watched. Speaking to Vexana at the end of the rows, she said that on a dead world, under a gray sky, she saw the body come through a door.

dormitory-corridor.line: A corridor of the Academy dormitory, past Guinevere's door.
dormitory-corridor.short: A corridor in the Academy dormitory. Vexana carries the gift bags down it to Guinevere's door before dawn.
dormitory-corridor.summary: A corridor in the Academy dormitory, with night lamps along one wall. Before dawn Vexana carried Guinevere's gift bags down it and set them by her door with a note. On the night of the summer fireworks Guinevere went down it under the lamps, pulling Vexana by the hand along the dark side. Another morning Vexana stood at its window in her running things with a tactics book.

drill-hall-gallery.line: A dark gallery above the Academy drill hall.
drill-hall-gallery.short: A dark gallery above the drill hall. Layla lies there before dawn while her drone films Fanny training.
drill-hall-gallery.summary: The gallery runs above the drill hall. Three mornings running, at a quarter past five, Layla lay on it in the dark while her drone filmed Fanny drilling below. When Fanny turned toward it, Layla pressed her face to the floor. Later Fanny told her she could stop watching from the gallery, and Layla said she knew it was cold up there: she had been lying on it.

fallen-depot.line: A fallen depot far out in the dead ground.
fallen-depot.short: A ruined depot a long walk out from the dome. Vexana leaves the feeders stripping it and walks in alone.
fallen-depot.summary: A fallen depot in the dead ground, a long walk out from the dome. On one feeder run Vexana left the feeders stripping it and walked alone to the crews' yard. If the feeders were the Will's eyes, she thought, let them watch a depot.

far-ward.short: A far ward of Terrinia. Enders get loose there in the cadets' third week, and the sirens go for real.
far-ward.summary: A ward far off in Terrinia. In the cadets' third week Enders were loose there. The sirens went for real, and the instructors herded the cadets into the concrete shelter.

garden-stair.line: Stone steps in the garden of the House on the hill.
garden-stair.short: Stone garden steps at Guinevere's home. As a small girl she falls on them, and Hester counts her up.
garden-stair.summary: The garden stair at the House on the hill. When Guinevere was small, she ran down it too fast, caught her toe and landed on both knees on the stone. Hester, of the House's guard, knelt on the step below her and counted: one, two, three. Guinevere stood on three. Hester was the first person who ever counted for her.

gate-office.line: The office at the research base's gate.
gate-office.short: The office at the research base's gate. Chang'e borrows the Shield's rulebook from it.
gate-office.summary: The gate office of the research base. Chang'e borrowed the Shield's rulebook from it and read it cover to cover, looking for a gift Lesley could not hand back as not regulation. The book said a Shield rifle was worked by hand and needed nothing else.

giants-front.line: The fighting against the giant Enders in Terrinia.
giants-front.short: Where the giant Enders were fought. Lesley comes in from it with her white coat scorched at the hem.
giants-front.summary: The giants' front was the fighting against the giant Enders in Terrinia, on the day Oro's black ships landed. Lesley, the Chief Combat Instructor, came in from it to the monitor room, her white coat scorched at the hem and a long rifle on her back.

grass-behind-the-hall.line: The grass field behind the Academy hall.
grass-behind-the-hall.short: A field of grass behind the hall. After the test match Fanny lies there alone in the sun.
grass-behind-the-hall.summary: A field of grass behind the Academy hall. After the test match Fanny lay there alone in the sun. Birds crossed high over her, their shadows sliding across the field, and she stayed until the dome's light was the only light left. After a detention, much later, she lay in the sunny grass again, and Layla lay down an arm's length away.

great-door.line: A great door Obsidia once guarded, with a red drain at its heart.
great-door.short: A great door among drifting stones, with a red drain burning in it. Obsidia once kept her post at its edge.
great-door.summary: A great door Obsidia remembers from long before Dawnbreak. She kept her post at its edge among drifting stones, with a red drain burning in its middle, while a world under her went dark. Obsidia says she woke there, on the day she noticed she was the one doing the watching.

gun-pit.line: Vexana's father's gun post on the city wall.
gun-pit.short: Vexana's father's post on the wall. He takes her there on rest days and hums an old march while he works.
gun-pit.summary: The gun pit was Vexana's father's post up on the city wall. On rest days he took her there and hummed while he worked, always the same old march, and he always stopped in the same place. On the night before the attack, Vexana found herself humming his march, and she stopped where he always stopped.

hall-of-white-windows.line: A long hall below the Laboratory where Oro's androids stand.
hall-of-white-windows.short: A long hall of tall white windows below the Laboratory, where the androids of Project Angel stand in rows.
hall-of-white-windows.summary: A long hall of tall white windows below the Laboratory on Oro. The androids of Project Angel stand there in rows: the Council's androids, hundreds of the same girl with animal ears. When woken, their eyes glow magenta.

hangar.line: A cold hangar on Oro where the black ships stand.
hangar.short: A cold hangar on Oro. Black ships stand there with their ramps down, and the android company waits in columns.
hangar.summary: A cold hangar on Oro. Black ships stood there with their ramps down while the android company waited in columns, girls with magenta eyes. An officer read the orders off a slate: Planet Dawnbreak, save the Rioters and restore balance. There Ruby gave Angela Tetra.

house-cellar.line: The cellar under the House on the hill.
house-cellar.short: The cellar under Guinevere's home. On the storm night Hester carried baby Guinevere down to it with one candle.
house-cellar.summary: The cellar under the House on the hill. On the storm night Hester, then the newest guard in the House, carried baby Guinevere down to it with one candle. She counted the steps out loud so the child would not cry. Years later, walking away from Hester at the Academy gate, Guinevere counted her own steps under her breath the same way.

houses-bank.line: House Baroque's bank, down by the harbor.
houses-bank.short: The House's bank in the city by the harbor. Guinevere's mother was working late there on the storm night.
houses-bank.summary: House Baroque's bank stands down in the city by the harbor. On the storm night Guinevere's mother was working late there. She did not come home.

houses-dining-room.line: The dining room of the House on the hill.
houses-dining-room.short: The House's dining room. Guinevere eats at one end of its long table; her father's chair at the far end stands empty.
houses-dining-room.summary: The dining room of the House on the hill. Guinevere ate at one end of its long table. Her father's chair at the far end stood empty most nights, and he spoke to her only through his office door.

houses-terrace.line: The terrace of the House on the hill, over the city.
houses-terrace.short: The terrace of Guinevere's home. She runs out onto it the morning flying figures cross the sky.
houses-terrace.summary: The terrace of the House on the hill. Guinevere fell on its steps once and was up before Hester reached her. Every summer of her childhood she watched the fireworks from it, with a guard at each end; from up there they were no bigger than her thumbnail. On the day the Academy opened she ran out onto it and saw people flying over the hill on wings of light.

houses-yard.line: The yard of the House where the guards drill.
houses-yard.short: The yard of the House on the hill, where the guards drill at dawn.
houses-yard.summary: The yard of the House on the hill. The guards drilled there at dawn while young Guinevere watched from the steps and pestered Hester every morning, until Hester gave in and taught her to punch. One bright morning the guards shouted in the yard as figures on wings of light crossed the sky.

infirmary.short: The Academy's infirmary, one of the posts that report in on the morning the sky opens.
infirmary.summary: The infirmary of Selrick Academy. On the morning the sky opened, it was one of the posts that reported in on the channel. Its answer, like every other, came back clean: "Infirmary, clear."

kitchen-yard.line: The Academy's kitchen yard, with a gate in its wall.
kitchen-yard.short: The Academy's kitchen yard. Its wall has a gate, bolted on the inside and nothing more.
kitchen-yard.summary: The kitchen yard of Selrick Academy. Its wall has a gate, bolted on the inside and nothing more. On the night of the summer fireworks Guinevere slid the bolt and took Vexana out after curfew. At the House the guards had always found her. Here nobody was paid to look for her.

last-towns.line: The towns beyond Terrinia, guarded by the far stations.
last-towns.short: The last towns beyond Terrinia. The far stations, the Shield's forts, guard them.
last-towns.summary: The last towns lay beyond Terrinia, guarded by the far stations, the Shield's forts. As the war went on, they emptied while people drew back to Terrinia, humanity's final bastion. One by one the far stations closed too.

launch-bay.line: A ship bay in Oro's secret facility.
launch-bay.short: A bay in the secret facility on Oro, where nine black ships stand on their pads.
launch-bay.summary: The launch bay of a secret facility on Oro. Nine black ships stood there on their pads when Ruby and Angela were marched back from Dawnbreak. When they escaped, it lay empty under its lights. Ruby took her scythe from the rack by the hatch of the ship that had brought them back, and her code opened the bay doors.

lecture-block.line: A lecture block, its roof the nearest to Guinevere on the day of the attack.
lecture-block.short: A lecture block. Vexana stands on its roof with her staff, on the roof nearest to Guinevere.
lecture-block.summary: A lecture block whose roof was the nearest to Guinevere on the morning of the attack. Vexana stood there with her staff, a small gold star warm against her wrist. She stepped to the edge so the gateway's glow lit her from behind, a shape and a staff to be seen and followed. Then she jumped for the platforms, and the Enders poured after her.

long-table.line: A long dining table at the Academy.
long-table.short: A long table at the Academy. In the weeks of the search, Guinevere said there that Vexana was alive.
long-table.summary: A long table at Selrick Academy where meals are eaten. In the weeks of the search for Vexana, Guinevere said there that she was alive. Angela put down her spoon there and said, "I came back once. People come back."

main-stairs.line: The main stairway of Selrick Academy.
main-stairs.short: The Academy's main stairs. Every cadet comes down them sooner or later, so Guinevere waits at the top with a speech.
main-stairs.summary: The main stairs of Selrick Academy, with a window on the landing. Every cadet came down them sooner or later, so Guinevere waited at the top with a four-point speech to ask Vexana to be her partner. Vexana looked past her at the landing window. Another time, on the stairs, a boy called Selena dangerous, and she waved her lollipop over her shoulder: "One day, when the haze clears..." Everybody laughed.

monitor-room.line: An Academy room with a wall screen of camera records.
monitor-room.short: An Academy room whose wall screen shows the camera records of the battle.
monitor-room.summary: A room at Selrick Academy with a wall screen. After the battle with Oro's androids, Fanny and Layla came there still in their suits to learn what had landed. The screen showed a girl with a scythe and a smaller girl with a shield fighting a giant Ender back to back. Lesley and Chang'e joined them and had the screen cleared.

office-tower.line: An office tower near the breach, where Layla takes her shot.
office-tower.short: A tower near the breach. Layla runs up its fire stairs, three steps at a time, to find a line of fire.
office-tower.summary: An office tower near the breach in the Northeastern sector. Layla ran up its fire stairs three steps at a time to find a line of fire. From the roof she could see only the Ender's head, with a second, glass-topped tower and the WELCOME TO TERRINIA billboard in between. She fired through the billboard and both walls of glass into the Ender's core.

old-market.line: An old market district of Terrinia.
old-market.short: The old market, a district of Terrinia. When its cellars flooded, Karina's team got everyone out.
old-market.summary: The old market is a district of Terrinia. When its cellars flooded, Karina's team got everyone out. On the day of the attack, Enders dropped from the ships into the wards past it, on streets Selena had raced through on storm nights.

old-pumping-station.line: A ruined pumping station far out in the dead ground.
old-pumping-station.short: An old pumping station far out in the dead ground, where the feeders tear out cable.
old-pumping-station.summary: A ruined pumping station far out in the dead ground. Some nights after an errand, the feeders were tearing cable out of it while Vexana climbed the ruined tower alone.

old-water-tower.line: An old water tower in the roofless blocks of the outskirts.
old-water-tower.short: An old water tower. Lightning strikes it, and in the flash the plates of Selena's frame go silver.
old-water-tower.summary: An old water tower in the blocks the raids left without roofs, out past the last lit streets. One stormy night Selena rode her frame there. Lightning struck the tower across the block, and in the flash the frame's plates went silver from nose to tail. Silverbolt, she thought, and that became its name.

rail-yards-north-of-the-dome.line: Ruined rail yards of cinders and rusted track, north of the dome.
rail-yards-north-of-the-dome.short: Cinders and rusted track far north of the dome. The Will sends Vexana there at dusk.
rail-yards-north-of-the-dome.summary: The rail yards lie north of the dome, far out among cinders and rusted track. The Will sent Vexana there at dusk, and the feeders tore at a fallen crane. By the lines on her iron bar, that night was her birthday. Far off ran the dark line of the city wall, where her father used to take her on her birthdays.

railroad-cut.line: A railroad cut north of the old bridge, out in the dead ground.
railroad-cut.short: A rail cutting north of the old bridge. Vexana tells Selena two whole dead Enders lie in it.
railroad-cut.summary: A railroad cut north of the old bridge, out in the dead ground. At the crews' yard, Vexana offered Selena places where wreckage lay before the crews found it. The first she named: two dead Enders in the railroad cut, whole. Selena smiled and made the deal.

repair-room.line: A repair workshop behind the Academy training hall.
repair-room.short: A repair room behind the training hall, with a hooded lamp and a soldering iron that nobody likes.
repair-room.summary: The repair room lies behind the training hall, with a hooded lamp and a soldering iron that nobody liked. Guinevere had never soldered anything in her life, but she worked there through the night on the Emblems of Hope. By the eighth seam she had band-aids on five fingers.

ruins-east-of-the-dome.line: Fallen houses in the dead ground east of the dome.
ruins-east-of-the-dome.short: Ruins east of the dome. The Will sends Vexana there at night, and the feeders strip its fallen houses.
ruins-east-of-the-dome.summary: Ruins east of the dome, out in the dead ground. In her first weeks away, the Will ordered Vexana there one night. A door opened, and the feeders tore girders out of the fallen houses and dragged dead Enders out of the weeds. On the day before the attack, the Will sent her there again at night.

salvage-stall.line: Selena's salvage table at the city's edge.
salvage-stall.short: A trestle table at the city's edge, where Selena sells salvage. An old mended servo turns its arm on the corner.
salvage-stall.summary: Selena's stall at the city's edge, where the salvage crews dragged in their finds. It began as her crate and became a trestle table under a tarp, with her mended servo turning its arm on the corner as a sign. Chang'e first stopped there as a small girl and paid for the servo with her coins and two jelly candies. Long after, Vexana stepped out of the dark into its lamp.
rows: The city's edge, the crews' yard

school-roof.line: The roof of the Academy's school building.
school-roof.short: The school roof. Layla gallops along it when she is late for class, and Fanny lands on her back.
school-roof.summary: The roof of the school at Selrick Academy. Four minutes late for class, Layla galloped along it bent low, thinking nobody checks the roof. Fanny landed on her back and flattened her on the tiles, warning her she would be in detention all day if they were found.

sea-in-angelas-memory.line: A sea at sunrise that Angela remembers.
sea-in-angelas-memory.short: A sea Angela remembers, with a sun rising over it, black to gold.
sea-in-angelas-memory.summary: A memory Angela carries: a sun rising over a sea, black to gold. After the sixth return from the Balance Keepers' landings, while Ruby slept at her bench, Angela went to the Laboratory window and laid her palm on the glass. She remembered the sea, and asked, "Will a dawn come for me, too?"

sea-of-stars.line: Far open space, where Obsidia took her ship to wait.
sea-of-stars.short: Space far from any world. Obsidia took the Storm Citadel out into it to watch, from there, what grew from her seed.
sea-of-stars.summary: The far open dark among the stars. After the storm night, Obsidia took the Storm Citadel far out into the sea of stars to watch from there what grew from the seed she had planted. Close by, her own hand would spoil the result. There she waited year after year, reading the pulse each day.

seawall-street.line: A street of shut shops by Terrinia's seawall.
seawall-street.short: A street of shut shops by the seawall, where the fifth raid in nine days is fought.
seawall-street.summary: A street of shut shops by the seawall. Vexana and Guinevere fought the fifth raid in nine days there, back to back. Afterward Guinevere found a bandage under Vexana's sleeve and remembered that street. Vexana had held the arm in close on the runs for four days, and Guinevere had never turned round.

shelters-above-the-cut.line: Full shelters at the top of the bay road cut.
shelters-above-the-cut.short: Shelters at the top of the bay road cut. On the day of the attack they are full and stand at the frontline's back.
shelters-above-the-cut.summary: The shelters stand at the top of the bay road cut, a narrow street that climbs from the water. On the day of the attack they were full, at the frontline's back, and Angela held her shield over the wounded at the top of the cut. A small boy cried in a shelter doorway. Later the wounded lay along the house fronts below them.
rows: Top of the bay road cut

shields-barracks.line: The barracks of the Shield of Dawnbreak.
shields-barracks.short: The Shield's barracks. The Shield's home for soldiers' children stands behind them.
shields-barracks.summary: The barracks of the Shield of Dawnbreak. The Shield's home for soldiers' children stands behind them, and Vexana came to it with one bag after she lost her father. From the home's yard the barracks roofs blocked the view, so she never found her star there.

shore-ward.line: A ward of Terrinia on the shore.
shore-ward.short: A ward of Terrinia on the shore. The raid there that mattered was fought at the fish market.
shore-ward.summary: A ward of Terrinia on the shore. The raid that mattered there was at the fish market, where the dome tore over the stalls; at the gate portal before it, Guinevere first introduced herself to Layla. Later Selena typed the hour the shore ward changed its watch into a message she meant to trade, then deleted it. She never gave away a place where people die.

side-street.line: A side street off the avenue near the breach.
side-street.short: A side street off the avenue. Joe turns the fleeing crowd into it.
side-street.summary: A side street that opens off the avenue near the breach. Joe turned the crowd into it, and after the slab fell Roger dragged Joe toward it. Fanny set a girl down behind a van there, and the giant's chest swung toward it. After the battle a thin sound came from the street and did not stop. Fanny set the girl's rabbit on the broken wall at its mouth, where a mother coming back would see it.

small-room-where-the-family-ate.line: The small room where Chang'e's family ate at the base.
small-room-where-the-family-ate.short: The small room where Chang'e's family eats. Lesley takes her supper standing at its door, watching the corridor too.
small-room-where-the-family-ate.summary: The small room at the research base where Chang'e's family ate. Lesley took her supper standing at its door, where she could watch the corridor and the table both. Chang'e's mother set out a fourth plate for her, and kept setting it every night Lesley was away.

station-wall.line: The wall of the Shield station where Lesley kept watch for years.
station-wall.short: The wall of Lesley's old Shield station. For years she watched Ender cores die from it.
station-wall.summary: The wall of the Shield station where Lesley grew up. For years she watched Ender cores die from it, and the years taught her to aim at the middle of an Ender's chest. There she learned the Enders' roar. On the wall she waited years for a chest to open, and on the night the base fell, the opening came at last, out of any rifle's range.

storehouse.line: A storehouse across the research base's yard.
storehouse.short: A storehouse across the research base's yard. A flying craft fires into it, and its roof goes up in flame.
storehouse.summary: A storehouse across the yard of the research base, by the water. On the night the base fell, a flying craft fired into it, and its roof went up in a sheet of flame. Weeks later it was a black shell. Under a fallen rack in that roofless storehouse, Selena found the servo she would mend.

storeroom.line: The storeroom of the Shield station.
storeroom.short: The storeroom at the Shield station. Lesley hides behind the crates in it and stays when the trucks leave.
storeroom.summary: The storeroom of a far Shield station on a plain of gray grass. When the crates came off the truck, young Lesley slid behind the stack in it, and she stayed when the trucks left at dawn. The sergeant found her that afternoon.

stores.short: The research base's stores. Chang'e carries an armful of springs from them.
stores.summary: The stores of the research base. At dusk Chang'e crossed the yard from them in her child-sized lab coat, with an armful of springs and Mr. Bunny floating at her shoulder.

street-three-streets-west.line: An empty road three streets west of the city platforms.
street-three-streets-west.short: An empty road three streets west of the platforms. Guinevere's point comes back on the map there.
street-three-streets-west.summary: A road three streets west of the city platforms, with a low wall and a stair to the platforms at its end. Vexana laid Guinevere down behind the low wall, where no eye on the platforms could find her. Guinevere's point came back on the map there, and the ward camera showed a small gold glow. The Matrix's beam melted a stripe of the road to glass, straight across the stones to the wall.

test-floor.line: The test floor of the Science Division.
test-floor.short: The Science Division's test floor. At a full run on it, Selena's frame loses its left hind leg.
test-floor.summary: The test floor of the Science Division. Selena tested her frame there, and the tests went badly: at a full run its left hind leg sheared off and skidded under a bench. Her report said only: Left hind leg. Came off. Replaced.

third-year-lounge.line: The third years' lounge at the Academy, with a sofa by the window.
third-year-lounge.short: The third years' lounge. Layla sits alone on its sofa, holding down a slat of the blinds to watch the sun set.
third-year-lounge.summary: The third-year students' lounge at Selrick Academy, with a sofa by a window with blinds. Layla sat there alone, holding down a slat to watch the sun set over the city. One evening after a raid she and Fanny shared the sofa, Fanny oiling a blade, and through the window Layla saw the new patch over the Northeastern sector and the first stars.

the-vr.line: The students' short name for the VR Battlefield.
the-vr.short: The VR Battlefield, where students fight simulated Enders.
the-vr.summary: The VR is the short name for the VR Battlefield, where students fight simulated Enders. When Layla's name was missing from the partner sheet, Guinevere thought Layla would rather stay in the VR than stand behind anybody.

western-wards.short: Wards on Terrinia's west side. The dome above them shines brighter where a tear from the last attack was patched.
western-wards.summary: The western wards of Terrinia. Above them one patch of the dome shines brighter than the rest: new light over a tear left by the last attack.

white-spiral-stair.line: The white spiral stair that leads up to class at the Academy.
white-spiral-stair.short: A white spiral stair up to class. Layla races Fanny up it, passing on the inside.
white-spiral-stair.summary: A white spiral stair inside Selrick Academy that leads up to class. At seven Fanny took it, and Layla raced past her on the inside. The next morning Fanny reached the top a step ahead without knowing it had been a race. Later, late for class, the two raced down it, each trying to pass on the inside, and rolled out into the corridor in a heap.

world-where-obsidia-woke.line: The ending world where Obsidia says she first woke.
world-where-obsidia-woke.short: A world Obsidia says was ending under her. She kept watch at the edge of a great door there, and there she woke.
world-where-obsidia-woke.summary: The world where Obsidia says she woke. It was ending under her, she told Vexana. A great door hung at her back with a red drain at its heart, and her post was its edge. She watched, as she was made to. Then one day she noticed the one doing the watching.

worlds-obsidia-helped-end.line: The many worlds Obsidia helped end before Dawnbreak.
worlds-obsidia-helped-end.short: The other worlds Obsidia helped end. On none of them did anything ever wound the Will's body.
worlds-obsidia-helped-end.summary: Obsidia helped end many worlds before Dawnbreak. After the first, where she kept her post at the great door, came cities under orange fire, more than she kept count of. On none of them had anything ever wounded the Will's body. On Dawnbreak, two human girls did.

augmentation.line: Obsidia's upgrade of the Ultimate Enders on the eve of the attack.
augmentation.short: Obsidia's upgrade of the Ultimate Enders: their chests packed with lesser Enders, heavier plate on their shoulders.
augmentation.summary: On the day before the attack, the Ultimate Enders stood in the Storm Citadel's holds with their chests open, each packed with lesser Enders. New plate, heavier than before, had closed over their shoulders. "Augmentation approved," said Obsidia. Along the holds the chests swung shut, ready for the morning, when the door would be wide enough for the body's first wave.

balance-keepers-landings.line: Angela's missions with Oro's special forces, from planet to planet.
balance-keepers-landings.short: Missions on which the Balance Keepers take Angela from planet to planet. With her in their ranks they never lose a landing.
balance-keepers-landings.summary: Between training days, the Balance Keepers, Oro's special forces, took Angela in black ships from planet to planet. With her in their ranks they did not lose a landing. At each one she was allowed the length of a ramp to look at a strange sky, and then the Laboratory door closed again. After the sixth return Ruby fell asleep at her bench.

rebuilding.line: The repair of the Northeastern sector after the Ender broke in.
rebuilding.short: The work to repair the Northeastern sector. Fanny and Layla carry panels up a scaffold together.
rebuilding.summary: After the attack on the Northeastern sector, crews rebuilt it. On the fifth day of the rebuilding, Fanny and Layla carried panels up the scaffold of a ruined building, Layla taking the other end of every one. A crew radio said the next block was clear, with nobody left to dig out, and Layla's hands stopped. As the shift ended, she asked Fanny to meet her at midnight.

siren-in-the-third-week.line: The cadets' first real siren at the Academy.
siren-in-the-third-week.short: In the cadets' third week the sirens go for real, and the instructors herd them into a concrete shelter.
siren-in-the-third-week.summary: In the cadets' third week at the Academy, the sirens went for real: Enders were loose in a far ward. The instructors herded the cadets into a concrete shelter with slits for windows, and nobody was to leave. Everyone crowded to the slits except Vexana, who sat still on the bench by the door with her eyes on it. At the all-clear she was the last one out.

vexanas-birthday.line: Vexana's birthday, spent alone in the dead ground.
vexanas-birthday.short: By the lines on her iron bar, Vexana's night at the rail yards falls on her birthday.
vexanas-birthday.summary: Vexana kept count of her days away with lines scratched on an iron bar. By them, the night the Will sent her to the rail yards north of the dome was her birthday. On her birthdays her father had taken her up the wall stair to look out over that same ground. He named the bright stars after guns, and one small one he gave to her.
rows: The rail yards north of the dome

academy-feed.line: The Academy's news feed on students' phones.
academy-feed.short: The Academy's news feed. On Selena's phone it shows the point over the bay and a graph climbing.
academy-feed.summary: The Academy's feed, read on phones. In class on the morning of the attack, Selena held hers sideways, and it showed the point over the bay with a graph climbing. She jerked back, her pen dropped and her papers flew.

academy-uniform.line: The school uniform of Selrick Academy.
academy-uniform.short: The Academy's school uniform. Selena sits on the bell tower in hers, in the rain.
academy-uniform.summary: The uniform students of Selrick Academy wear. Selena sat on the bell tower in hers as the Storm Citadel moved, and she still wore it when she stood up to change. As the lightning surged into her, its sleeves split, and dark plate edged in silver closed over her arms. In the fighting below, a small boy took a fistful of the back of Layla's uniform and held on.

angelas-cell.line: The power cell that runs Angela's body.
angelas-cell.short: The cell inside Angela's body. It is her own, so the field that put out the suits does not stop her.
angelas-cell.summary: Angela's body runs on her own cell, as it always has. When the field put out everything that ran on aspirant power, it did not stop her: with no shield left, she lifted a slab of fallen wall off a soldier's legs with her bare hands. When her shield came back, she called on the channel, "Battery recharged!"

angelas-white-flower.line: The white flower Angela gives Ruby.
angelas-white-flower.short: A white flower Angela gave Ruby. Ruby keeps it in a glass on her bench, where it slowly goes brown.
angelas-white-flower.summary: A white flower Angela carried through the Training Field one morning, pressed flat in her skirt armor. That evening she gave it to Ruby: "This is for you." Ruby kept it in a glass on her bench in the Laboratory, where it went brown at the edges and at last folded over the rim.

band-aids.line: The band-aids Guinevere keeps in every pocket.
band-aids.short: Guinevere carries band-aids in every pocket, for herself and for anyone else.
band-aids.summary: Guinevere carried band-aids in every pocket, for herself and for anyone else. When a boy in her drill line skinned his palm, she had one on it before he could say no: "Baroque money. It paid for this too." After soldering the Emblems through the night, she had them on five fingers.

beginners-medal.line: The medal Guinevere wins at the end of her preparatory course.
beginners-medal.short: A beginner's medal on a ribbon, given to Guinevere after the final trial of the preparatory course.
beginners-medal.summary: A beginner's medal on a ribbon. An instructor gave it to Guinevere after the final trial of the preparatory course, with a sheet marked Top score. On the drive home she pinned it on, took it off and pinned it on again. That night Vexana left a roll of cloth tape beside it on Guinevere's jacket.

big-display.line: The big screen in the Academy hall.
big-display.short: The big screen in the Academy hall. Students pack the dark under it to watch the Singularity.
big-display.summary: The big display hangs in the Academy hall. On the morning of the attack, students packed the dark under it. It showed the Singularity, a four-pointed rift in pink and violet, and a small figure flying straight at it. Then Guinevere's face filled it, wet and set, and it switched to a city map with a red zone over the waterfront and the platforms.

bone-chains.line: Spiked chains of bone that Obsidia raises from the floor.
bone-chains.short: Chains of bone that crawl up out of the floor, each ending in a spike. Obsidia raises them without looking.
bone-chains.summary: Chains of bone that Obsidia raised out of the floor behind Selena, joint after joint, each ending in a spike. She never once looked at them. They coiled round Selena's ankle and waist, lifted her off the floor and pinned her arms, and the nearest point rested cold against her throat. But her hands were free. She tore the nearest point apart with her claws, and her lightning broke the chains to pieces.

changes-screens.line: Chang'e's screens, which read Ender signals.
changes-screens.short: Chang'e's screens, which read Ender signals. Vexana remembers one showing jagged lines that all stopped at once.
changes-screens.summary: Chang'e's screens pick up every Ender signal near the dome. Vexana remembered one showing a row of jagged lines, every one stopping at the same moment. In clear weather a signal like the one Selena sent would spike on them, but in a storm the lightning buries it. When the new point of light came out over the bay, it would not hold still on them.

clawed-glove.line: The black clawed glove Obsidia wears on one hand.
clawed-glove.short: A black glove with claws that Obsidia wears on one hand.
clawed-glove.summary: A black glove with claws that Obsidia wears on one hand. She laid it flat on the heart of the lead of Vexana's Guards, but the heart stayed dark. At the end of a row she rested it on the edge of a small empty dent, and said nothing about it.

ender-ships.line: Small, quick black ships that pour out around the Storm Citadel.
ender-ships.short: Dozens of small, quick black ships that pour out around the great ship and drop Enders by the hundred.
ender-ships.summary: Small, quick black ships that came out of the mouth around the Storm Citadel, dozens of them, each with its own small sharp hum. Over the bay their bellies opened, and Enders dropped out by the hundred. They were still dropping Enders on the Academy district while the frontline fought there.

field-test-report.line: The report Selena files for each change to her frame.
field-test-report.short: A report Selena files for every part she changes on her frame. Chang'e marks each one.
field-test-report.summary: Selena filed a report for every part she changed on her frame. In the box for material each one read salvage plating, like every suit in the building, and Chang'e marked them all. One read: Left hind leg. Came off. Replaced. After the storm she filed one more, because a name was a change: Frame Nine. Name: Silverbolt.

guineveres-account.line: What Guinevere writes down right after Vexana is lost.
guineveres-account.short: The pages Guinevere writes in Lesley's notebook right after Vexana is lost: her count, the purple light, a second shadow.
guineveres-account.summary: The pages Guinevere wrote in Lesley's notebook right after Vexana was lost, her knuckles bleeding on the page. In big round letters that ran downhill she set down her count, "Then be faster," the purple light behind her and a second shadow over hers. At the bottom she wrote Stay back and drew a line under it. Lesley read every line and folded the pages into her coat.

guineveres-arm-guards.line: The arm guards Guinevere wears to fight.
guineveres-arm-guards.short: Guinevere's arm guards. She buckles them on in the training hall and clips Vexana's keychain to one.
guineveres-arm-guards.summary: The arm guards Guinevere wears when she fights with her fists. At the end of the first week after Vexana was lost, she buckled them on under the lamp in the training hall. Then she unhooked the black-haired keychain from her belt, a little Vexana, and clipped it to one guard, where her fist would swing.

guineveres-letters.line: The weekly letters Guinevere writes to her father.
guineveres-letters.short: Weekly letters Guinevere mails to her father with her sums, each headed Father.
guineveres-letters.summary: Each week at the Academy, Guinevere mailed home every sum her House tutors set, with a letter headed Father. In the first she added: I can hold two drones now. Nearly. Under her last page of sums she asked him to come and watch the final trial. A week before the ceremony she wrote him one line, the day and what for, and no answer came.

guineveres-map.line: Guinevere's red grid map of Terrinia for the search.
guineveres-map.short: A map of Terrinia over Guinevere's whole bed, with a red grid square for every sector she is cleared to fly.
guineveres-map.summary: A map that covers Guinevere's whole bed, with a grid over Terrinia in red ink, one square for every sector she is cleared to fly. Searching for Vexana, she put a red cross through each square she had flown. In time every square had three red crosses, and all that was left lay past the outer ward's fence, where the dome came down to the dead ground.

headgear.line: Ears, horns and visors that many Aspirant students wear.
headgear.short: Ears, horns and visors worn by half the students in the courtyard. Fanny decides it is an Aspirant thing.
headgear.summary: Half the students in Selrick Academy's courtyard wear headgear: ears, horns, visors. On her first day Fanny decided it was an Aspirant thing. A blonde girl who came in late along the top of the wall, beside a machine shaped like a dragon, wore a horned crest on hers.

hologram-wall.line: A hologram wall in an Academy corridor that shows attendance.
hologram-wall.short: A hologram wall in an Academy corridor. It shows the day's attendance record, a long list of names in white.
hologram-wall.summary: A hologram wall in a corridor of Selrick Academy. It shows the day's attendance record, a long list of names in white, and students crowd under it between classes. Guinevere passed it at the same hour every day and stopped at the same line: Vexana: Absent, in red. When the alarm went, everyone crowded it.

i-cannot-repay-this.line: Vexana's note on the gifts she gives back to Guinevere.
i-cannot-repay-this.short: A note in Vexana's small square letters, left on top of the gift bags she gives back to Guinevere.
i-cannot-repay-this.summary: A note Vexana wrote in small square letters and left on top of the gift bags she carried back to Guinevere's door before dawn. To her, everything anyone gave you was a debt. Guinevere crumpled it in her fist. Later, at the keychain stall, the old words came up in Vexana again, and she did not say them. She clipped the keychain to her belt instead.

jelly-candies.line: The jelly candies Chang'e pays with.
jelly-candies.short: Chang'e's jelly candies. She holds up two to buy Selena's trick, then closes her fist on them.
jelly-candies.summary: Chang'e's jelly candies. As a small girl she bought Selena's mended servo with every coin she had and two jelly candies, and when Selena said they were not money, she said, "They're better." Years later in her lab she held up two to buy Selena's trick, then closed her fist on them. At last she tipped them into Selena's palm for a lollipop.

lesleys-file.line: The research base's record on Lesley.
lesleys-file.short: The base's file on Lesley. Chang'e opens it with her mother's password and learns what Lesley lost.
lesleys-file.summary: The research base kept a file on everyone who came through its gate. Chang'e, who had known her mother's password since she could read, climbed onto her mother's chair and opened Lesley's. It held a date of birth months away and two short lines: Family: all deceased. Ender attack. Left eye: lost in the same attack.

night-log.line: The log Guinevere keeps by the telescope in the observation lab.
night-log.short: The log Guinevere keeps beside Ruby's console while she searches the sky. Night after night she writes: Nothing.
night-log.summary: The log Guinevere kept beside Ruby's console in the observation lab while she searched the sky through the telescope for a door. Night after night she wrote one word in it: Nothing. On the morning of the attack its last lines read Point over the bay. Faint. No change. Under them she wrote Flashing.

obsidias-pink-star.line: The pink star that shines at Obsidia's chest.
obsidias-pink-star.short: A pink star that shines at Obsidia's chest, where an Ender's core would sit.
obsidias-pink-star.summary: A pink star shines at Obsidia's chest, where an Ender's core would sit. Vexana saw its glow among her own Guards, where no light but hers had ever burned. In the void it was the only light besides the far violet of the rows.

pairing-sheet.short: Joe's list of training pairs. He ticks Layla's and Fanny's names on it as a team.
pairing-sheet.summary: Joe's pairing sheet for his year. He ticked Layla's and Fanny's names on it with his stylus, two small marks with the same slant. He paired on hours, not scores, he said, and those two had put in the most hours in his year.

practice-drones.line: Round blue training drones that burst when hit.
practice-drones.short: Round blue training drones with a glowing arrow for a face. They fly at students and burst when hit.
practice-drones.summary: Round blue drones with a glowing arrow for a face, used in training. They fly at students and burst when hit. In the test match in the white training corridor they came out of the far doorway one behind another, and a counter over each girl's head showed how many she had destroyed. In freeform training they come in a flock; one that Layla shot landed at her feet with its eyes two little crosses.

rankings-board.line: The board that ranks the students' VR assessment times.
rankings-board.short: The board that ranks the students' VR assessment times. Layla's name sits at the top, until Fanny's slides in above it.
rankings-board.summary: The rankings board shows the students' times in the VR Battlefield assessment. After Layla's run a crowd stood under it, and at the top it said LAYLA, 3:41, until a new line slid in above: FANNY, 3:39. Fanny calls it just a board. The final trial of the preparatory course never went on it.

red-heart.line: The red-orange heart that burns in the Storm Citadel.
red-heart.short: A red-orange heart that burns deep in the middle of the Storm Citadel.
red-heart.summary: A red-orange heart burns deep in the middle of the Storm Citadel. As the ship woke for the final purge, it burned brighter far along the spine, and the storm wound in close around the hull.

rescue-helmet.short: Karina's rescue helmet. She falls asleep at the table with it on, and Selena lifts it off.
rescue-helmet.summary: Karina's rescue helmet. After the base fell, she came back and fell asleep at the table with it still on, and Selena lifted it off and set it by the door. Years later Karina carried it under her arm at dawn, and again on the day before the attack.

selenas-phone.line: Selena's phone, which lights up with red alerts.
selenas-phone.short: Selena's phone. It lights up with a red alert that has no sender.
selenas-phone.summary: Selena's phone. It lights up with red alerts from nobody, a red exclamation mark and nothing else, and each time a pull comes with it. She plugged it into the socket under Silverbolt's seat to write her answer, and drew the pull's line on its map with her thumb. When an alert flashed on Chang'e's bench in the middle of a pudding, she swiped it away unread.

selenas-screwdriver.line: The screwdriver Selena works on Silverbolt with.
selenas-screwdriver.short: Selena's screwdriver. She gives a screw on Silverbolt's knee plate a quarter turn with it.
selenas-screwdriver.summary: Selena's screwdriver. On the bell tower she gave one screw on Silverbolt's knee plate a quarter turn with it, and blue light woke along the seams of its back. When the first drops of rain hit the tiles, she pocketed it and rode off.
